big_case.notes: Judge's read: an as-applied Commerce Clause challenge to the cyberstalking statute turning on whether intrastate phone use is per se use of an instrumentality of interstate commerce. The doctrinal question would reach many federal statutes keyed on facilities of interstate commerce, but the asserted conflict is one motor-vehicle decision against a long line of telephone holdings, the record carried alternative jurisdictional hooks, and the petition was denied without any noted writing. Moderate doctrinal stakes, low public stakes.
